description: Retire the OpenShell runtime: remove agro sandbox install openshell, the OpenShell execution target, docs, validation journey, and tests; keep the agro run default image under defaultImage(config).

userStories.title: Remove the OpenShell runtime from the CLI and the image
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the CLI and the sandbox image to hold no OpenShell code. Then Docker is the only persistent sandbox runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/cli/src/lib/execution/openshell-target.ts`, `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/openshell-target.test.ts`, `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/openshell-runtime-contract.test.ts`, `.devcontainer/openshell-main.sh`, and `.devcontainer/agro-image-env.sh` do not exist.

The worker renames `.devcontainer/openshell-policy.yaml` to `.devcontainer/egress-policy.yaml`. The new file holds only the `version` key and the `network_policies` section. `egressAllowHosts({ version: 1 })` returns the same host list as before the rename.

`lib/execution/index.ts` exports `defaultImage(config)` in place of `openshellImage(config)`. `defaultImage` returns `image.ref` when `image.ref` is not empty, and `officialImageRef(AGRO_VERSION)` otherwise. `agro run` container mode uses `defaultImage` when `--image` is absent.
`RUNTIME_CATALOG` holds `docker` and `microsandbox` only. `SANDBOX_RUNTIMES` equals `["docker"]`. The agro.json `runtime` field accepts only `"docker"`.
`agro sandbox install openshell` exits 1 and prints `unknown runtime "openshell"`.

The worker deletes each code path that only a non-docker runtime reaches. The paths are the OpenShell branches in `commands/sandbox.ts`, `lib/execution/index.ts`, `lib/registry.ts`, `commands/egress.ts`, and `lib/runtimes/verbs.ts`, plus the OpenShell lines of the `controllers/sandbox.ts` help text.
`git grep -n -i openshell -- .agro/cli .devcontainer` prints nothing.
`agro run -- pnpm run typecheck` exits 0.
`agro run -- pnpm test` exits 0.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: test -e on the 5 paths, none exist. 2 executed: egress-policy.yaml holds version + network_policies; egress-policy.test.ts asserts the 6-host list, passes. 3 executed: defaultImage in lib/execution/index.ts, run.ts:328 uses it; run.test.ts default-image cases pass. 4 executed: tool-catalog and agro-config tests pass with docker-only values. 5 executed: sandbox.test.ts asserts exit 1 and unknown runtime message, passes. 6 reasoned: diff review shows install path, execution-target branch, openshellFiles, egress refusal, verbs.ts, entryRuntime, help lines deleted; docker paths unchanged. 7 executed: git grep -n -i openshell -- .agro/cli .devcontainer exit 1 (no output). 8 executed: agro run -- pnpm run typecheck exit 0. 9 executed: agro run -- pnpm test exit 1; only failures are docs-reference.test.ts (2) for docs/configuration.md:130 and docs/security-considerations.md:253 links to the renamed policy, owned by US-002, added to US-002 criteria; cli-first-help failures were a concurrent-run race and pass alone (27/27).

userStories.title: Remove OpenShell from the docs, the sandbox skill, and the changelog
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the docs and the sandbox skill to describe only the Docker runtime. Then no instruction routes work to a removed runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/runtimes/openshell.md` and `.agro/skills/sandbox/checks/openshell-journey.sh` do not exist.
`.agro/skills/sandbox/references/validation.md` has no OpenShell journey scenario, and its contents list has no link to that scenario.

Routing case R8 in `.agro/scripts/__tests__/fixtures/sandbox-routing/cases.json` asks for a persistent Docker workspace. The R8 oracle stays `{ "route": "lifecycle", "owners": ["lifecycle", "herdr", "worktrees"] }`.

`instructionFiles` in `.agro/scripts/__tests__/helpers/sandbox-routing.ts` does not list `docs/runtimes/openshell.md`. The provenance test in `.agro/scripts/__tests__/sandbox-routing.test.ts` names only existing documents.
`CHANGELOG.md` `## [Unreleased]` has a `### Removed` entry for `agro sandbox install openshell` and the OpenShell runtime.
`git grep -n -i openshell -- ':!.agro/tasks' ':!CHANGELOG.md' ':!.agro/scripts/__tests__/fixtures/sandbox-routing/decisions.json'` prints nothing.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh` exits 0 on each changed Markdown file in `docs/` and `.agro/skills/sandbox/`.
`docs/configuration.md` and `docs/security-considerations.md` link `.devcontainer/egress-policy.yaml`, and `agro run -- pnpm exec vitest run .agro/cli/src/__tests__/docs-reference.test.ts` exits 0.
userStories.notes: Round 1 extended files with sandbox-skill.test.ts (heading and checks counts); repair commit 6b0cae68. 1 executed: test -e on both paths, neither exists; git grep openshell-journey matches only CHANGELOG. 2 executed: grep -c -i openshell validation.md = 0; worker renumbered Third..Fifth and anchors; sandbox-skill.test.ts passes. 3 executed: R8 prompt says persistent Docker workspace; jq shows oracle unchanged. 4 executed: grep openshell in helper and routing test prints nothing. 5 executed: CHANGELOG Unreleased has ### Removed entry linking #1652. 6 executed: git grep with the three exclusions exit 1. 7 executed: ste-check.sh exit 0 on all 9 changed Markdown files. 8 executed: both docs link ../.devcontainer/egress-policy.yaml; docs-reference.test.ts passes in full run. Full run: agro run -- pnpm test exit 1, 3439/3440 pass; the one failure is the stale observed replay in sandbox-routing.test.ts that US-003 re-records.

userStories.title: Record the sandbox routing replay again
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the routing replay to match the new instruction files so that the routing test proves the current sandbox skill.
acceptanceCriteria: Seventeen fresh decision-only agents record one decision each for R1 to R17 against the final instruction files and `cases.json`.
Each record in `.agro/scripts/__tests__/fixtures/sandbox-routing/decisions.json` matches its oracle.
The provenance in `decisions.json` comes from `sourceProvenance()`.
`agro run -- pnpm exec vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/sandbox-routing.test.ts` exits 0.
`agro run -- pnpm test` exits 0.

userStories.title: Capture the manual review transcript
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a command transcript from the branch CLI so that I can see the removed runtime. The transcript also shows the kept `agro run` default image.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/retire-openshell-runtime/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the commands and the observed output.
The transcript builds the branch CLI with `agro run -- pnpm run build:harness`.
The transcript shows `node .agro/cli/dist/agro.js sandbox install openshell` exits 1 with `unknown runtime "openshell"`.
The transcript shows `node .agro/cli/dist/agro.js sandbox install --help` lists no `openshell` runtime.

The transcript creates a new temp git project, and the project does not exist before the run. The project agro.json sets `image.ref` to `alpine:3.20`. In the project, `node <worktree>/.agro/cli/dist/agro.js run -- cat /etc/alpine-release` exits 0 and prints the Alpine version. The transcript deletes the temp project at the end.
